tool_args.rationale: The paid trajectories contain eight varied histories and horizons, enough to fit the four parameters of the verified coupled memory-kernel ODE. The model reconstructs the latent initial memory from each irregularly sampled raw prefix using shifted time intervals, then integrates the two-state system by RK4 and numerically fits the parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight diverse trajectories are now available, satisfying the mechanism note's minimum count for fitting the four coupled-memory parameters; no further paid observation is needed before fitting.

The supplied signatures include endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag, while the verified Maxwell law only uses the endpoint input difference and horizon and cannot represent the history-conditioned coupled transient.

considered_alternatives.option: coarse adiabatic slow-ODE or static balance
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These reduced models omit the history-dependent latent state and are inconsistent with the supplied temporal-regime guidance.
It is unrelated to identifying the stated coupled memory ODE and is explicitly unnecessary.
